    rPinchSearchMin                 : REAL;                     (* Minimum approach locator *)
    rFilterRollInput                : REAL;                     (* Filtered roll acceleration *)
    rFilterPitchInput               : REAL;                     (* Filtered pitch acceleration *)
END_VAR

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(*                                   MAIN EXECUTABLE ALGORITHM                                          *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 1: MASTER MATRIX COEFFICIENTS INITIALIZATION (FIRST SCAN BOOTSTRAP)                         *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bStateInitPulse AND (iSystemState = cSTATE_BOOT_AND_INERT) THEN
    (* Initialize State-Space Plant Matrix A (7x7 Discrete Time, Ts=0.1s) *)
    (* A represents physical coupled dynamics of ullage capacitance, heat transfer, and kinetics *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
            matA[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
            matC[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
            matKalmanGain[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        matA[iIdx, iIdx] := 1.0; (* Diagonal identity baseline *)
        matC[iIdx, iIdx] := 1.0; (* Direct state observation *)
        matKalmanGain[iIdx, iIdx] := 0.15; (* Default filter observer baseline *)
    END_FOR;

    (* Ullage pressure integrating dynamics with pneumatic venting leakage *)
    matA[1, 1] := 0.9982;    matA[1, 2] := 0.0985;    matA[1, 5] := -0.000125;
    matA[2, 1] := -0.0150;   matA[2, 2] := 0.8850;    matA[2, 5] := -0.002400;
    (* BAHX cold end temperature response to Nelium refrigerant and mass flow *)
    matA[3, 3] := 0.9450;    matA[3, 5] := 0.00085;   matA[3, 7] := 0.052000;
    (* Ortho-to-para conversion residual decay over catalyst bed *)
    matA[4, 3] := 0.0120;    matA[4, 4] := 0.8200;    matA[4, 5] := 0.000450;
    (* Condensation mass flow dynamic inertia *)
    matA[5, 1] := 1.2500;    matA[5, 3] := -0.4500;   matA[5, 5] := 0.910000;
    (* Nelium high-pressure cycle loop inventory response *)
    matA[6, 6] := 0.9650;    matA[6, 7] := -0.0150;
    (* Expander exhaust cryogenic temperature dynamics *)
    matA[7, 6] := 0.0350;    matA[7, 7] := 0.8950;

    (* Fine-tune Kalman Observer Gain Matrix L (7x7) *)
    matKalmanGain[1, 1] := 0.350;  matKalmanGain[1, 2] := 0.045;
    matKalmanGain[2, 1] := 0.120;  matKalmanGain[2, 2] := 0.420;
    matKalmanGain[3, 3] := 0.280;  matKalmanGain[3, 7] := 0.015;
    matKalmanGain[4, 4] := 0.220;
    matKalmanGain[5, 5] := 0.310;  matKalmanGain[5, 1] := 0.055;
    matKalmanGain[6, 6] := 0.250;
    matKalmanGain[7, 7] := 0.290;  matKalmanGain[7, 6] := 0.018;

    (* Initialize Discrete Input Coupling Matrix B (7x5) *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
            matB[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
            matD[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    (* u[1]=CompSpeed, u[2]=ExpIGV, u[3]=JTValve, u[4]=Bypass, u[5]=GCUSendout *)
    matB[1, 1] := -0.000015; matB[1, 4] := 0.000350;  matB[1, 5] := -0.000850;
    matB[2, 1] := -0.000280; matB[2, 4] := 0.005500;  matB[2, 5] := -0.014200;
    matB[3, 1] := -0.000450; matB[3, 2] := -0.08500;  matB[3, 3] := -0.045000;
    matB[4, 2] := -0.015000; matB[4, 3] := -0.02200;  matB[4, 4] := 0.005000;
    matB[5, 1] := 0.085000;  matB[5, 2] := 1.250000;  matB[5, 4] := -2.150000; matB[5, 5] := -3.500000;
    matB[6, 1] := 0.000950;  matB[6, 2] := -0.04200;
    matB[7, 1] := -0.000120; matB[7, 2] := -0.11500;  matB[7, 3] := 0.008000;

    (* Initialize Disturbance Coupling Matrix E (7x3) *)
    (* d[1]=ShipSloshInertia, d[2]=AtmBaroChange, d[3]=InsulationHeatLeak *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
            matE_dist[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    matE_dist[1, 1] := 0.0180;  matE_dist[1, 2] := -0.0010; matE_dist[1, 3] := 0.00008;
    matE_dist[2, 1] := 0.3500;  matE_dist[2, 2] := -0.0200; matE_dist[2, 3] := 0.00150;
    matE_dist[3, 3] := 0.0250;
    matE_dist[5, 1] := 1.8500;  matE_dist[5, 3] := 0.4200;

    (* Initialize MPC Quadratic Weighting Penalties *)
    vec_Q_diag[1] := 500.0;     (* Heavy penalty on ullage pressure deviation *)
    vec_Q_diag[2] := 80.0;      (* Penalty on pressure rate-of-change (damping) *)
    vec_Q_diag[3] := 150.0;     (* Penalty on BAHX cold-end temperature drift *)
    vec_Q_diag[4] := 250.0;     (* Severe penalty on unconverted ortho-hydrogen *)
    vec_Q_diag[5] := 15.0;      (* Mass flow rate tracking penalty *)
    vec_Q_diag[6] := 10.0;      (* Refrigerant high-pressure loop stability *)
    vec_Q_diag[7] := 45.0;      (* Expander exhaust temperature stability *)

    vec_R_diag[1] := 0.0025;    (* Compressor motor speed change energy penalty *)
    vec_R_diag[2] := 0.8500;    (* Expander IGV mechanical wear suppression *)
    vec_R_diag[3] := 1.2000;    (* Cryogenic JT valve cycle suppression *)
    vec_R_diag[4] := 0.4500;    (* Hot-gas bypass valve hunting suppression *)
    vec_R_diag[5] := 5.0000;    (* High penalty on flaring hydrogen to GCU *)

    (* Actuator Hard Saturation Bounds *)
    vec_u_lower_bound[1] := 15000.0;  vec_u_upper_bound[1] := 36000.0; (* Compressor [rpm] *)
    vec_u_lower_bound[2] := 10.0;     vec_u_upper_bound[2] := 100.0;   (* Expander IGV [%] *)
    vec_u_lower_bound[3] := 0.0;      vec_u_upper_bound[3] := 100.0;   (* JT Valve [%] *)
    vec_u_lower_bound[4] := 0.0;      vec_u_upper_bound[4] := 100.0;   (* Bypass Valve [%] *)
    vec_u_lower_bound[5] := 0.0;      vec_u_upper_bound[5] := 100.0;   (* GCU Sendout [%] *)

    (* Actuator Slew Rate Bounds per 100ms scan *)
    vec_delta_u_max[1] := 250.0; (* Max 2500 rpm/sec *)
    vec_delta_u_max[2] := 2.5;   (* Max 25%/sec *)
    vec_delta_u_max[3] := 1.5;   (* Max 15%/sec *)
    vec_delta_u_max[4] := 10.0;  (* Fast bypass response 100%/sec *)
    vec_delta_u_max[5] := 5.0;   (* GCU valve ramp 50%/sec *)

    (* Initialize Approximate Hessian Diagonal elements: H_ii = sum(B_ji^2 * Q_j) + R_i *)
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (matB[iIdx, jIdx] * matB[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_Q_diag[iIdx]);
        END_FOR;
        mat_Hessian_diag[jIdx] := rTempSum + vec_R_diag[jIdx];
    END_FOR;

    (* Initialize BAHX 10-Node Structural Thermal Characteristics *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 10 DO
        (* Temperature profile gradient from 295 K warm end down to 20.28 K cold end *)
        rNodeTemp_NeliumHP[iIdx]     := 300.0 - (INT_TO_REAL(iIdx - 1) * 31.0);
        rNodeTemp_NeliumLP[iIdx]     := 292.0 - (INT_TO_REAL(iIdx - 1) * 31.0);
        rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx]     := 295.0 - (INT_TO_REAL(iIdx - 1) * 30.5);
        rNodeUA_Rating[iIdx]         := 12.5 + (INT_TO_REAL(iIdx) * 1.8); (* Enhanced cold-end fins *)
        (* Catalyst activity profile: concentrated in lower temperature stages (nodes 6 to 10) *)
        IF iIdx <= 5 THEN
            rCatalystBedActivity[iIdx] := 0.20;
        ELSE
            rCatalystBedActivity[iIdx] := 1.00; (* Full hydrous ferric oxide packing *)
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSING & FAILURE DIAGNOSTICS                       *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rPressArray[1] := rCargoTankUllagePress_A;
rPressArray[2] := rCargoTankUllagePress_B;
rPressArray[3] := rCargoTankUllagePress_C;

rTempArray[1] := rBOG_SuctionTemp_A;
rTempArray[2] := rBOG_SuctionTemp_B;
rTempArray[3] := rBOG_SuctionTemp_C;

(* Update Sensor History Ring Buffer for Frozen Sensor Detection *)
iHistoryIndex := (iHistoryIndex MOD 5) + 1;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, iHistoryIndex] := rPressArray[iIdx];
    rTempHistoryRing[iIdx, iHistoryIndex]  := rTempArray[iIdx];
END_FOR;

(* Channel Sanity Checks: Out of Range [0.8 to 2.5 bar], Freeze, and Slew-Rate Verification *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    (* Out of range physical checks *)
    IF (rPressArray[iIdx] < 0.800) OR (rPressArray[iIdx] > 2.500) THEN
        bPressChanFault[iIdx] := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    (* Sensor Freeze Detection: exactly zero variation over 5 scans while vessel is moving *)
    IF (rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 1] = rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 2]) AND
       (rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 2] = rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 3]) AND
       (rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 3] = rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 4]) AND
       (rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 4] = rPressHistoryRing[iIdx, 5]) AND
       ((ABS(rShipRollAngle_deg) > 0.4) OR (ABS(rShipPitchAngle_deg) > 0.2)) THEN
        (* Cargo is actively sloshing, ullage MUST vary dynamically. Constant value indicates stuck ADC *)
        bPressChanFault[iIdx] := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    (* Temperature range checks [15K to 320K] *)
    IF (rTempArray[iIdx] < 15.0) OR (rTempArray[iIdx] > 320.0) THEN
        bTempChanFault[iIdx] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Inter-Channel Deviation Checks (Discrepancy Drift Detection > 0.040 bar for > 2.5 seconds) *)
IF NOT bPressChanFault[1] AND NOT bPressChanFault[2] THEN
    IF ABS(rPressArray[1] - rPressArray[2]) > 0.040 THEN
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[1] := rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[1] + rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S;
    ELSE
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[1] := MAX(0.0, rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[1] - rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF NOT bPressChanFault[2] AND NOT bPressChanFault[3] THEN
    IF ABS(rPressArray[2] - rPressArray[3]) > 0.040 THEN
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[2] := rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[2] + rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S;
    ELSE
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[2] := MAX(0.0, rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[2] - rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF NOT bPressChanFault[3] AND NOT bPressChanFault[1] THEN
    IF ABS(rPressArray[3] - rPressArray[1]) > 0.040 THEN
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[3] := rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[3] + rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S;
    ELSE
        rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[3] := MAX(0.0, rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[3] - rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Isolate Drifting Channels exceeding 2.5s persistence *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    IF rPressDiscrepancyTimer_s[iIdx] > 2.50 THEN
        bPressChanFault[iIdx] := TRUE; (* Flag isolated channel *)
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Count Healthy Channels *)
iHealthyPressChans := 0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    IF NOT bPressChanFault[iIdx] THEN
        iHealthyPressChans := iHealthyPressChans + 1;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

iHealthyTempChans := 0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    IF NOT bTempChanFault[iIdx] THEN
        iHealthyTempChans := iHealthyTempChans + 1;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Voting Logic with Graceful Degradation: 2oo3 -> 1oo2 -> 1oo1 -> Fail-Safe Trip *)
IF iHealthyPressChans = 3 THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Selection: copy to buffer and sort *)
    rSortBuffer[1] := rPressArray[1];
    rSortBuffer[2] := rPressArray[2];
    rSortBuffer[3] := rPressArray[3];
    (* 3-element bubble sort *)
    IF rSortBuffer[1] > rSortBuffer[2] THEN
        rTempSwap := rSortBuffer[1]; rSortBuffer[1] := rSortBuffer[2]; rSortBuffer[2] := rTempSwap;
    END_IF;
    IF rSortBuffer[2] > rSortBuffer[3] THEN
        rTempSwap := rSortBuffer[2]; rSortBuffer[2] := rSortBuffer[3]; rSortBuffer[3] := rTempSwap;
    END_IF;
    IF rSortBuffer[1] > rSortBuffer[2] THEN
        rTempSwap := rSortBuffer[1]; rSortBuffer[1] := rSortBuffer[2]; rSortBuffer[2] := rTempSwap;
    END_IF;
    rVotedUllagePressure_bar := rSortBuffer[2]; (* True median *)
    bDegradedSensorMode := FALSE;
ELSIF iHealthyPressChans = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Voting: Select Maximum for Overpressure Protection Conservatism *)
    rTempMaxPress := -999.0;
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF NOT bPressChanFault[iIdx] THEN
            IF rPressArray[iIdx] > rTempMaxPress THEN
                rTempMaxPress := rPressArray[iIdx];
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    rVotedUllagePressure_bar := rTempMaxPress;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSIF iHealthyPressChans = 1 THEN
    (* Severely Degraded 1oo1 Operation: Direct single channel with advisory *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF NOT bPressChanFault[iIdx] THEN
            rVotedUllagePressure_bar := rPressArray[iIdx];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Loss (0 healthy channels): Force safe default and initiate ESD trip *)
    rVotedUllagePressure_bar := 1.300; (* Force conservative high pressure reading *)
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Temperature Sensor Voting (Median or Valid Average) *)
IF iHealthyTempChans >= 2 THEN
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF NOT bTempChanFault[iIdx] THEN
            rTempSum := rTempSum + rTempArray[iIdx];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    rVotedBOG_Temp_K := rTempSum / INT_TO_REAL(iHealthyTempChans);
ELSIF iHealthyTempChans = 1 THEN
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        IF NOT bTempChanFault[iIdx] THEN
            rVotedBOG_Temp_K := rTempArray[iIdx];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    rVotedBOG_Temp_K := 25.0; (* Default cryogenic vapor temperature *)
END_IF;

(* Filtered Pressure Derivative dP/dt [bar/s] *)
rRawPressDerivative := (rVotedUllagePressure_bar - rPrevVotedPress_bar) / rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S;
rUllagePressureRate_bar_s := (0.85 * rUllagePressureRate_bar_s) + (0.15 * rRawPressDerivative);
rPrevVotedPress_bar := rVotedUllagePressure_bar;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 3: MARINE SLOSHING INERTIAL WAVE NOTCH FILTER & ULLAGE FLOAT ESTIMATOR                      *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* In 160,000 m3 membrane / prismatic tanks, vessel roll and pitch excite standing wave sloshing       *)
(* with primary resonance at ~0.12 Hz (omega_0 = 0.754 rad/s). The resulting hydrostatic dynamic wave  *)
(* pressure oscillates at the dome transmitters, falsely tricking pressure controllers.                *)
(* We implement an active 2nd-order notch filter to strip hydraulic slosh and reveal pure gas ullage. *)

rFilterRollInput := rShipRollAngle_deg * 0.0174533;   (* Convert to radians *)
rFilterPitchInput := rShipPitchAngle_deg * 0.0174533;

(* Discrete Direct-Form II Notch Filter at 0.12 Hz with damping zeta=0.15 *)
(* b0 = 0.952, b1 = -1.890, b2 = 0.952, a1 = -1.890, a2 = 0.904 *)
rFilterRoll_x1 := (0.952 * rFilterRollInput) - (-1.890 * rFilterRoll_x1) - (0.904 * rFilterRoll_x2);
rFilterRoll_x2 := rFilterRoll_x1;

rFilterPitch_x1 := (0.952 * rFilterPitchInput) - (-1.890 * rFilterPitch_x1) - (0.904 * rFilterPitch_x2);
rFilterPitch_x2 := rFilterPitch_x1;

(* Calculate Dynamic Hydrostatic Wave Head: rho_LH2 = 70.85 kg/m3, tank semi-width = 18.5 m *)
rSloshPressureHeadCorrection := (rCONST_LH2_DENSITY_KG_M3 * (9.81 + rShipHeaveAcc_m_s2) *
    (rCONST_TANK_SEMI_WIDTH_M * SIN(rFilterRoll_x1) + (rCONST_TANK_LENGTH_M * 0.5) * SIN(rFilterPitch_x1))) / 100000.0; (* bar *)
rCompensatedUllagePress_bar := rVotedUllagePressure_bar - (0.35 * rSloshPressureHeadCorrection);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 4: MULTI-STREAM BAHX 10-NODE THERMAL INTEGRATION & ORTHO-PARA KINETICS                      *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Ortho-to-Para Conversion Thermodynamics:                                                             *)
(* Boltzmann Rotational Partition Function approximation for Para fraction at temperature T:           *)
(* x_p_eq(T) = 1.0 / (1.0 + 3.0 * EXP(-175.0 / T) + 7.0 * EXP(-1050.0 / T))                            *)
(* Heat of conversion: 527.1 kJ/kg released continuously into refrigerant cooling stream               *)

rPinchSearchMin := 999.0;
rTotalColdDuty_kW := 0.0;
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 10 DO
    (* Calculate Local Hydrogen Temperature Profile along the 10 nodes *)
    IF iIdx = 1 THEN
        rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[1] := rBAHX_WarmEndTemp_K;
        rNodeParaFraction[1] := rOrthoParaInletRatio_Pct;
        rNodeEnthalpy_Hydrogen[1] := (rCONST_H2_CP_GAS_KJ_KG_K * (rBAHX_WarmEndTemp_K - 20.28)) + rCONST_H2_LATENT_HEAT_KJ_KG;
    ELSE
        (* Progressive cooling step *)
        rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] := rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx - 1] - ((rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[1] - rBAHX_ColdEndTemp_K) / 9.0);
    END_IF;

    (* Evaluate Theoretical Equilibrium Para-Hydrogen Fraction at local node temperature *)
    IF rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] > 100.0 THEN
        rParaEquilibrium := 25.0 + (50.0 * (100.0 / rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx]));
    ELSIF rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] > 30.0 THEN
        rParaEquilibrium := 75.0 + (24.0 * ((100.0 - rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx]) / 70.0));
    ELSE
        (* Cryogenic plateau nearing 20.28 K *)
        rParaEquilibrium := rCONST_PARA_EQUILIBRIUM_20K - (0.015 * (rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] - 20.28));
    END_IF;
    rParaEquilibrium := MIN(100.0, MAX(25.0, rParaEquilibrium));

    (* Catalytic Reaction Kinetics: d(x_p)/dt = k_cat * (x_p_eq - x_p)^1.8 *)
    rReactionDrivingForce := MAX(0.0, rParaEquilibrium - rNodeParaFraction[iIdx]);
    rConversionRate := 0.185 * rCatalystBedActivity[iIdx] * EXPT(rReactionDrivingForce, 1.8);

    (* Update Para Fraction at Next Node *)
    IF iIdx < 10 THEN
        rNodeParaFraction[iIdx + 1] := MIN(rParaEquilibrium, rNodeParaFraction[iIdx] + (rConversionRate * 0.05));
    END_IF;

    (* Calculate Exothermic Heat Generation in Node [kW] *)
    rExothermicHeat_kW := (rBOG_MassFlow_kg_h / 3600.0) * (rConversionRate / 100.0) * rCONST_OP_CONV_HEAT_KJ_KG;

    (* Counter-Current Nelium Refrigerant Temperatures *)
    rNodeTemp_NeliumHP[iIdx] := rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] - 4.5 - (INT_TO_REAL(iIdx) * 0.25);
    rNodeTemp_NeliumLP[iIdx] := rNodeTemp_NeliumHP[iIdx] - 2.8;

    (* Local Temperature Approach / Pinch Delta T between hot hydrogen and cold Nelium *)
    rNodeDeltaT_Pinch[iIdx] := rNodeTemp_Hydrogen[iIdx] - rNodeTemp_NeliumLP[iIdx];
    IF rNodeDeltaT_Pinch[iIdx] < rPinchSearchMin THEN
        rPinchSearchMin := rNodeDeltaT_Pinch[iIdx];
    END_IF;

    (* Compute local nodal heat flux exchanged [kW] *)
    rNodeHeatExchanged_kW[iIdx] := rNodeUA_Rating[iIdx] * rNodeDeltaT_Pinch[iIdx];
    rTotalColdDuty_kW := rTotalColdDuty_kW + rNodeHeatExchanged_kW[iIdx];
END_FOR;
rBAHX_MinimumPinchObserved_K := rPinchSearchMin;
rCalculatedOrthoParaPurity_Pct := rNodeParaFraction[10];

(* Total Cryogenic Refrigeration Load: Sensible Cool (300K->20K) + Latent Heat (445.8 kJ/kg) + Ortho-Para Conversion (527 kJ/kg) *)
rTotalCoolingDemand_kW := (rBOG_MassFlow_kg_h / 3600.0) * (
    (rCONST_H2_CP_GAS_KJ_KG_K * MAX(0.0, rBAHX_WarmEndTemp_K - 20.28)) +
    rCONST_H2_LATENT_HEAT_KJ_KG +
    (((rCalculatedOrthoParaPurity_Pct - rOrthoParaInletRatio_Pct) / 100.0) * rCONST_OP_CONV_HEAT_KJ_KG)
);

(* Actual Brayton Refrigeration Capacity from Turbo-Expander *)
rBraytonRefrigCapacity_kW := (rRefrigCompPower_kW * 0.72) * (MAX(10.0, rExpanderInletTemp_K - rExpanderExhaustTemp_K) / 280.0);
IF rRefrigCompPower_kW > 1.0 THEN
    rCryogenicEfficiency_COP := rBraytonRefrigCapacity_kW / rRefrigCompPower_kW;
ELSE
    rCryogenicEfficiency_COP := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Condensation Yield Rate *)
IF rTotalCoolingDemand_kW > 0.0 THEN
    rBOG_ReliquefiedRate_kg_h := rBOG_MassFlow_kg_h * MIN(1.0, rBraytonRefrigCapacity_kW / rTotalCoolingDemand_kW);
ELSE
    rBOG_ReliquefiedRate_kg_h := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 5: DISCRETE KALMAN OBSERVER STATE ESTIMATION                                                 *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Assemble Measurement Vector y_meas *)
vec_y_meas[1] := rCompensatedUllagePress_bar - rTargetUllagePress_bar;
vec_y_meas[2] := rUllagePressureRate_bar_s;
vec_y_meas[3] := rBAHX_ColdEndTemp_K - 20.28;
vec_y_meas[4] := rCONST_PARA_EQUILIBRIUM_20K - rCalculatedOrthoParaPurity_Pct;
vec_y_meas[5] := rBOG_MassFlow_kg_h - rBOG_ReliquefiedRate_kg_h;
vec_y_meas[6] := rRefrigCycleHighPress_bar - 18.50;
vec_y_meas[7] := rExpanderExhaustTemp_K - 16.50;

(* Observer Innovation: y_meas - C*x_hat *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matC[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_x_hat[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    vec_x_innov[iIdx] := vec_y_meas[iIdx] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* State Correction: x_corrected = x_hat + L * innovation *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matKalmanGain[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_x_innov[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    vec_x[iIdx] := vec_x_hat[iIdx] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* External Disturbance Estimation *)
vec_dist[1] := rFilterRoll_x1 + rFilterPitch_x1;                  (* Hydrodynamic slosh surge *)
vec_dist[2] := rAtmosphericPressure_kPa - 101.325;                 (* Barometric offset *)
vec_dist[3] := (rTotalLiquidVolume_m3 * 0.0015 * rCONST_LH2_DENSITY_KG_M3 * rCONST_H2_LATENT_HEAT_KJ_KG) / 86400.0; (* Heat leak kW *)

(* One-Step Ahead Observer Time Update: x_hat(k+1) = A*x(k) + B*u(k) + E*dist(k) *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matA[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_x[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matB[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_u[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matE_dist[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_dist[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    vec_x_hat[iIdx] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) RECDING HORIZON QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION                  *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Multi-Step State Horizon Projection (Np = 5) *)
FOR hIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
            IF hIdx = 1 THEN
                rTempSum := rTempSum + (matA[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_x[jIdx]);
            ELSE
                rTempSum := rTempSum + (matA[iIdx, jIdx] * mat_PredStateHorizon[hIdx - 1, jIdx]);
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (matB[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_u[jIdx]);
        END_FOR;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (matE_dist[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_dist[jIdx]);
        END_FOR;
        mat_PredStateHorizon[hIdx, iIdx] := rTempSum;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Evaluate Quadratic Cost Gradient: g = sum_i( B_ji * Q_i * (x_pred_i) ) + R_j * delta_u_j *)
FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 7 DO
        (* Weight sum over first 3 horizon steps *)
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matB[iIdx, jIdx] * vec_Q_diag[iIdx] * (mat_PredStateHorizon[1, iIdx] + 0.8 * mat_PredStateHorizon[2, iIdx] + 0.5 * mat_PredStateHorizon[3, iIdx]));
    END_FOR;
    vec_Gradient[jIdx] := rTempSum + (vec_R_diag[jIdx] * (vec_u[jIdx] - vec_u_prev[jIdx]));
END_FOR;

(* Active-Set Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Loop (Hildreth / Frank-Wolfe approximation) *)
IF (iSystemState = cSTATE_ACTIVE_RELIQUEFACTION) OR (iSystemState = cSTATE_HIGH_SLOSH_TRANSIENT) THEN
    FOR kIdx := 1 TO iQP_MaxIterations DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
            (* Gradient descent step scaled by inverse approximate Hessian *)
            vec_delta_u[jIdx] := - (vec_Gradient[jIdx] / MAX(0.001, mat_Hessian_diag[jIdx])) * rQP_LearningRate;
            (* Slew Rate Saturation Projection *)
            vec_delta_u[jIdx] := MIN(vec_delta_u_max[jIdx], MAX(-vec_delta_u_max[jIdx], vec_delta_u[jIdx]));
            (* Candidate Actuator Command Update *)
            vec_u[jIdx] := vec_u[jIdx] + vec_delta_u[jIdx];
            (* Physical Actuator Hard Boundary Clamping *)
            vec_u[jIdx] := MIN(vec_u_upper_bound[jIdx], MAX(vec_u_lower_bound[jIdx], vec_u[jIdx]));
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Ullage Pressure Float Interlock Overrides: If Ullage is safely inside deadband, save compressor power *)
IF (ABS(vec_x[1]) < rCONST_ULLAGE_FLOAT_BAND_BAR) AND (iSystemState = cSTATE_ACTIVE_RELIQUEFACTION) THEN
    (* Within deadband: hold compressor speed constant, trim IGV to minimum power *)
    vec_u[1] := MAX(15000.0, vec_u[1] * 0.998);
    vec_u[4] := 0.0; (* Zero hot-gas spillback *)
    vec_u[5] := 0.0; (* Zero flaring to GCU *)
END_IF;

(* Thermal Pinch Protection Override: If approach < 1.5 K, immediately open JT valve and trim IGV *)
IF rBAHX_MinimumPinchObserved_K < rCONST_MIN_PINCH_ALLOWABLE_K THEN
    vec_u[3] := MIN(100.0, vec_u[3] + 15.0); (* Boost JT expansion subcooling *)
    vec_u[2] := MAX(10.0, vec_u[2] - 5.0);   (* Pinch guide vanes to adjust pressure ratio *)
END_IF;

(* Assign Actuator Demands *)
rRefrigCompSpeedDemand_rpm := vec_u[1];
rExpanderIGV_Demand_Pct    := vec_u[2];
rJouleThomsonValve_Pct     := vec_u[3];
rBOG_BypassValve_Pct       := vec_u[4];
rGCU_MassFlowDemand_kg_h   := (vec_u[5] / 100.0) * rBOG_MassFlow_kg_h;

(* Store Previous Actuator Values for Next Scan Delta *)
FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    vec_u_prev[jIdx] := vec_u[jIdx];
END_FOR;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 7: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) WITH SAFETY INTERLOCKS                            *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S;

CASE iSystemState OF
    cSTATE_BOOT_AND_INERT: (* STATE 0: Cold Unpressurized Shutdown *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPlantInReliquefaction := FALSE;
        bEmergencyVentRequired := FALSE;
        bGCU_SendoutDemand := FALSE;
        bBOG_CompressorTripDemand := FALSE;
        vec_u[1] := 0.0;    (* Compressor stopped *)
        vec_u[2] := 0.0;    (* IGV closed *)
        vec_u[3] := 0.0;    (* JT closed *)
        vec_u[4] := 100.0;  (* Bypass open *)
        vec_u[5] := 0.0;    (* GCU closed *)

        IF bMasterEnable AND bSafetyInterlockOK THEN
            iSystemState := cSTATE_PRE_START_INTERLOCK_CHK;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            bStateInitPulse := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    cSTATE_PRE_START_INTERLOCK_CHK: (* STATE 10: Safety Loop & Barrier Verification *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        IF NOT bSafetyInterlockOK THEN
            iSystemState := cSTATE_BOOT_AND_INERT;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        ELSIF bInertingPurgePermissive AND bColdBoxVacuumPermissive AND bSeawaterCoolingFlowOK AND
              (iHealthyPressChans >= 2) AND (iHealthyTempChans >= 2) THEN
            IF rStateTimer_s > 5.0 THEN
                iSystemState := cSTATE_NELIUM_PURGE_INVENTORY;
                rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
                bStateInitPulse := TRUE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    cSTATE_NELIUM_PURGE_INVENTORY: (* STATE 20: Nelium Mixture Quality Check *)
        (* Verify Nelium gas density matches 80 mol% He / 20 mol% Ne (~7.24 kg/m3 at 18 bar, 300K) *)
        IF (rCycleGasDensity_kg_m3 > 6.0) AND (rCycleGasDensity_kg_m3 < 8.5) AND (rRefrigCycleHighPress_bar > 12.0) THEN
            IF rStateTimer_s > 10.0 THEN
                iSystemState := cSTATE_CONTROLLED_CHILLDOWN;
                rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
                rChilldownRampTemp_K := rBAHX_WarmEndTemp_K;
                bStateInitPulse := TRUE;
            END_IF;
        ELSIF rStateTimer_s > 60.0 THEN
            (* Timeout on charge verification: trip back *)
            iSystemState := cSTATE_BOOT_AND_INERT;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    cSTATE_CONTROLLED_CHILLDOWN: (* STATE 30: Controlled Cryogenic Chilldown (<= 5.0 K/hr) *)
        (* Strictly control cooldown rate to prevent catastrophic thermal stress in aluminum core *)
        rChilldownRampTemp_K := MAX(22.0, rChilldownRampTemp_K - (rCONST_MAX_COOLING_RATE_K_MIN * (rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S / 60.0)));
        vec_u[1] := 18000.0; (* Minimum compressor speed *)
        vec_u[2] := 25.0;    (* Modest expander expansion *)
        vec_u[3] := 10.0;    (* Gradual JT opening *)
        vec_u[4] := 50.0;    (* High spillback to limit mass flow *)

        IF rBAHX_ColdEndTemp_K <= 24.0 THEN
            iSystemState := cSTATE_BRAYTON_BOOTSTRAP;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            bStateInitPulse := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    cSTATE_BRAYTON_BOOTSTRAP: (* STATE 40: Compander Synchronization & Speedup *)
        vec_u[1] := 24000.0;
        vec_u[2] := 60.0;
        vec_u[4] := 15.0; (* Close bypass *)
        IF (rExpanderSpeed_rpm > 45000.0) AND (rBAHX_ColdEndTemp_K <= 21.0) THEN
            iSystemState := cSTATE_ACTIVE_RELIQUEFACTION;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            bStateInitPulse := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    cSTATE_ACTIVE_RELIQUEFACTION: (* STATE 50: Closed-Loop Steady State MPC Reliquefaction *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bPlantInReliquefaction := TRUE;
        bGCU_SendoutDemand := FALSE;

        (* Detect Rough Sea Motion Transition *)
        IF (ABS(rShipRollAngle_deg) > 8.0) OR (ABS(rShipPitchAngle_deg) > 4.0) THEN
            iSystemState := cSTATE_HIGH_SLOSH_TRANSIENT;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Detect Severe Boil-Off Over-Capacity *)
        IF (rCompensatedUllagePress_bar > (rTargetUllagePress_bar + 0.120)) AND (rBOG_MassFlow_kg_h > 3200.0) THEN
            iSystemState := cSTATE_GCU_SENDOUT_PEAK_SHAVE;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Operator Controlled Shutdown *)
        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iSystemState := cSTATE_CONTROLLED_WARMUP;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            rWarmupRampTemp_K := rBAHX_ColdEndTemp_K;
        END_IF;

    cSTATE_HIGH_SLOSH_TRANSIENT: (* STATE 60: Rough Sea Feedforward Motion Damping *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bPlantInReliquefaction := TRUE;
        (* Broaden MPC pressure float deadband dynamically to prevent compressor thrashing *)
        IF (ABS(rShipRollAngle_deg) < 5.0) AND (ABS(rShipPitchAngle_deg) < 2.5) AND (rStateTimer_s > 30.0) THEN
            iSystemState := cSTATE_ACTIVE_RELIQUEFACTION;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    cSTATE_GCU_SENDOUT_PEAK_SHAVE: (* STATE 70: Divert Excess BOG to Gas Combustion Unit *)
        bGCU_SendoutDemand := TRUE;
        (* Open GCU split valve proportional to pressure overshoot *)
        vec_u[5] := MIN(100.0, (rCompensatedUllagePress_bar - rTargetUllagePress_bar) * 500.0);
        IF (rCompensatedUllagePress_bar < (rTargetUllagePress_bar + 0.040)) AND (rStateTimer_s > 45.0) THEN
            vec_u[5] := 0.0;
            bGCU_SendoutDemand := FALSE;
            iSystemState := cSTATE_ACTIVE_RELIQUEFACTION;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    cSTATE_CONTROLLED_WARMUP: (* STATE 80: Defrost and Controlled Thermal Restoration *)
        bPlantInReliquefaction := FALSE;
        rWarmupRampTemp_K := MIN(295.0, rWarmupRampTemp_K + (rCONST_MAX_COOLING_RATE_K_MIN * 1.5 * (rCONST_SAMPLE_TIME_S / 60.0)));
        vec_u[1] := MAX(0.0, vec_u[1] - 150.0);
        vec_u[2] := 10.0;
        vec_u[3] := 0.0;
        vec_u[4] := 100.0;
        IF (vec_u[1] <= 0.0) AND (rBAHX_ColdEndTemp_K > 270.0) THEN
            iSystemState := cSTATE_BOOT_AND_INERT;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    cSTATE_EMERGENCY_VENT_TRIP: (* STATE 90: SIL-3 Emergency Mast Venting & Compander Fast Trip *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bPlantInReliquefaction := FALSE;
        bEmergencyVentRequired := TRUE;
        bBOG_CompressorTripDemand := TRUE;
        vec_u[1] := 0.0;    (* Hard trip compressor *)
        vec_u[2] := 0.0;    (* Fast close expander IGV *)
        vec_u[3] := 0.0;    (* Fast close JT valve *)
        vec_u[4] := 100.0;  (* Full open bypass spillback *)
        vec_u[5] := 100.0;  (* Max flow divert to GCU *)
        IF bAcknowledgeAlarms AND NOT bLatchedOverpressureTrip AND (rVotedUllagePressure_bar < 1.150) THEN
            bEmergencyVentRequired := FALSE;
            bBOG_CompressorTripDemand := FALSE;
            iSystemState := cSTATE_BOOT_AND_INERT;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

ELSE
    (* Unrecognized state trap: force safe shutdown *)
    iSystemState := cSTATE_BOOT_AND_INERT;
    rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
END_CASE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 8: CRITICAL ALARM & SAFETY INTERLOCK SUPERVISORY TREES                                       *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Timer: Tank High-High Overpressure persistence (1.250 bar for > 1.0 second) *)
tUllageHighHighTimer(IN := (rVotedUllagePressure_bar >= rCONST_ULLAGE_TRIP_HIGH_BAR), PT := T#1S000MS);
IF tUllageHighHighTimer.Q THEN
    bLatchedOverpressureTrip := TRUE;
    dwTripFirstOutWord := dwTripFirstOutWord OR 16#00000001;
    iSystemState := cSTATE_EMERGENCY_VENT_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* Timer: BAHX Pinch Safety Violation (< 1.0 K for > 5.0 seconds implies freezing/thermal crossover) *)
tPinchSafetyTimer(IN := (rBAHX_MinimumPinchObserved_K < 1.00), PT := T#5S000MS);
IF tPinchSafetyTimer.Q THEN
    bLatchedThermalShockTrip := TRUE;
    dwTripFirstOutWord := dwTripFirstOutWord OR 16#00000002;
    iSystemState := cSTATE_CONTROLLED_WARMUP;
END_IF;

(* Timer: Compressor Rotational Overspeed (> 37,500 rpm for > 200 ms) *)
tCompanderOverspeedTimer(IN := (rRefrigCompSpeed_rpm > 37500.0), PT := T#200MS);
IF tCompanderOverspeedTimer.Q THEN
    bLatchedCompanderSurgeTrip := TRUE;
    dwTripFirstOutWord := dwTripFirstOutWord OR 16#00000004;
    iSystemState := cSTATE_EMERGENCY_VENT_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* Timer: Cold-Box Annular Vacuum Loss (< 1.0e-3 mbar lost for > 2.0 seconds) *)
tVacuumLossTimer(IN := NOT bColdBoxVacuumPermissive, PT := T#2S000MS);
IF tVacuumLossTimer.Q THEN
    bLatchedVacuumFailureTrip := TRUE;
    dwTripFirstOutWord := dwTripFirstOutWord OR 16#00000008;
    iSystemState := cSTATE_EMERGENCY_VENT_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* Timer: Dual Sensor Loss Trip (fewer than 2 operational pressure sensors for > 3.0 seconds) *)
tSensorDiscrepancyTripTimer(IN := (iHealthyPressChans < 2), PT := T#3S000MS);
IF tSensorDiscrepancyTripTimer.Q THEN
    dwTripFirstOutWord := dwTripFirstOutWord OR 16#00000010;
    iSystemState := cSTATE_EMERGENCY_VENT_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* Reset Latched Trips on Operator Acknowledge *)
IF bAcknowledgeAlarms THEN
    IF rVotedUllagePressure_bar < rCONST_ULLAGE_TRIP_HIGH_BAR THEN
        bLatchedOverpressureTrip := FALSE;
    END_IF;
    bLatchedThermalShockTrip := FALSE;
    bLatchedCompanderSurgeTrip := FALSE;
    bLatchedVacuumFailureTrip := FALSE;
    IF (iSystemState <> cSTATE_EMERGENCY_VENT_TRIP) THEN
        dwTripFirstOutWord := 16#00000000;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Master General Alarm Aggregation *)
bGeneralAlarm := bLatchedOverpressureTrip OR
                 bLatchedThermalShockTrip OR
                 bLatchedCompanderSurgeTrip OR
                 bLatchedVacuumFailureTrip OR
                 bDegradedSensorMode OR
                 (rBAHX_MinimumPinchObserved_K < rCONST_MIN_PINCH_ALLOWABLE_K) OR
                 (rCalculatedOrthoParaPurity_Pct < 95.0);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SECTION 9: 32-BIT STATUS & ALARM BITFIELD PACKING                                                    *)
(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* dwStatusWord: Bit 0: Ready, Bit 1: Reliquefaction Active, Bit 2: Degraded 1oo2/1oo1,              *)
(*               Bit 3: High Slosh Mode, Bit 4: GCU Divert, Bit 5: Emergency Vent Open,              *)
(*               Bit 6: Vacuum Permissive, Bit 7: Seawater Cooling OK,                                *)
(*               Bits 8-15: System State Integer Byte                                                  *)
dwStatusWord := 16#00000000;
IF bSystemReady THEN dwStatusWord := dwStatusWord OR 16#00000001; END_IF;
IF bPlantInReliquefaction THEN dwStatusWord := dwStatusWord OR 16#00000002; END_IF;
IF bDegradedSensorMode THEN dwStatusWord := dwStatusWord OR 16#00000004; END_IF;
IF iSystemState = cSTATE_HIGH_SLOSH_TRANSIENT THEN dwStatusWord := dwStatusWord OR 16#00000008; END_IF;
IF bGCU_SendoutDemand THEN dwStatusWord := dwStatusWord OR 16#00000010; END_IF;
IF bEmergencyVentRequired THEN dwStatusWord := dwStatusWord OR 16#00000020; END_IF;
IF bColdBoxVacuumPermissive THEN dwStatusWord := dwStatusWord OR 16#00000040; END_IF;
IF bSeawaterCoolingFlowOK THEN dwStatusWord := dwStatusWord OR 16#00000080; END_IF;
dwStatusWord := dwStatusWord OR SHL(INT_TO_DWORD(iSystemState), 8);

(* dwAlarmWord: Bit 0: Overpressure High Trip, Bit 1: Thermal Shock Trip, Bit 2: Surge Trip,        *)
(*              Bit 3: Vacuum Failure Trip, Bit 4: Pinch Warning (< 1.5K),                             *)
(*              Bit 5: Low Ortho-Para Purity (< 95%), Bit 6: Sensor A Fault,                           *)
(*              Bit 7: Sensor B Fault, Bit 8: Sensor C Fault, Bit 9: Total Sensor Failure             *)
dwAlarmWord := 16#00000000;
IF bLatchedOverpressureTrip THEN dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000001; END_IF;
IF bLatchedThermalShockTrip THEN dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000002; END_IF;
IF bLatchedCompanderSurgeTrip THEN dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000004; END_IF;
IF bLatchedVacuumFailureTrip THEN dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000008; END_IF;
IF rBAHX_MinimumPinchObserved_K < rCONST_MIN_PINCH_ALLOWABLE_K THEN dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000010; END_IF;
IF rCalculatedOrthoParaPurity_Pct < 95.0 THEN dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000020; END_IF;
IF bPressChanFault[1] THEN dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000040; END_IF;
IF bPressChanFault[2] THEN dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000080; END_IF;
IF bPressChanFault[3] THEN dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000100; END_IF;
IF iHealthyPressChans = 0 THEN dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000200; END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
